The task failed because the generated summary lacked standard currency formatting, specifically missing comma separators for large numeric values.
The verifier failed in test_summary_contains_key_outputs with AssertionError: Summary missing value 72,766.88. While the calculation was correct ($72766.88), the summary formatting omitted the required comma separator. Avoid raw float-to-string conversion; ensure values like total_annual_revenue_90_day_usd match the expected f"{value:,.2f}" format in the final summary.md output.
